categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the manufacturing of plastics and related raw materials, including PVC powder, plastic resins, and chemical products. It also produces plastic building materials, plastic fabrics, and plastic leather products. Additionally, the company provides chemical machinery and equipment services, including VCM plant equipment design and installation, and engages in groundwater remediation services. The business is vertically integrated, covering production, storage, sales, import/export, and commissioned processing of related products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes polymerization and drying processes for PVC powder production, oxygen-chlorination reactions for EDC production, and polymerization for PVC powder from VCM. It applies advanced manufacturing techniques including AI intelligent control for process optimization and energy efficiency improvements. The company also employs integrated physical, chemical, and biological methods for groundwater remediation, emphasizing environmentally friendly microbial technologies. It holds certifications such as ISO 14001, ISO 45001, ISO 50001, and GRS for environmental and quality management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include downstream plastic processing industries, electronics and semiconductor sectors, and construction industries. The company serves domestic markets in Taiwan and exports to regions including Southeast Asia, South Asia (India, Bangladesh), Middle East, South America, Africa, North America, and Europe. Major end markets include automotive, furniture, medical, and industrial sectors, with specific products tailored for automotive seat covers, furniture upholstery, and building materials.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan with production facilities in Hsinchu and Kaohsiung areas. It exports products globally to markets in Southeast Asia, South Asia, Middle East, South America, Africa, North America, Europe, and Australia. It maintains international sales and marketing offices and has established supply chains and customer relationships across these regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the petrochemical supply chain. It produces key raw materials such as VCM and PVC powder and further processes these into plastic products like plastic fabrics, leather, and building materials. It also provides technical services and equipment manufacturing for chemical plants, positioning itself as an integrated manufacturer and supplier within the plastics and chemical industry chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include upgrading aging and energy-intensive equipment, applying AI intelligent technologies to optimize processes and energy use, and expanding diversified and high-value markets. R&D focuses on developing environmentally friendly materials, such as recycled plastics and low-solvent surface treatments, and innovative products like cooling leather, transparent films, and antiviral coatings. The company emphasizes sustainability, carbon reduction, and compliance with international environmental standards, aiming for carbon neutrality by 2050.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of chemical raw materials (VCM, EDC), PVC powder, plastic building materials, plastic fabrics, and plastic leather products. Additional income comes from technical services related to chemical plant equipment and groundwater remediation services. The company also engages in export sales to international markets, with revenue derived from product sales and commissioned processing.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading PVC and VCM producer in Taiwan and a major global PVC exporter. It competes with other regional petrochemical and plastics manufacturers, including large integrated producers in China and Southeast Asia. Its vertical integration, product quality, environmental certifications, and diversified product portfolio provide competitive advantages. The company faces challenges from overcapacity and price competition but leverages technological innovation and market diversification to maintain its industry position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated net sales of approximately NT$11.1 billion in the latest fiscal year, a decrease from the prior year, with a net loss attributable to owners of about NT$710 million. Total assets were around NT$18 billion, with equity of approximately NT$8.7 billion. Capital expenditures are significant, focusing on equipment upgrades and environmental compliance. The company faces market challenges but plans steady growth through innovation and operational improvements.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes product quality, stable supply, and customer service as key differentiators. It offers vertically integrated products from raw materials to finished plastic goods, ensuring cost control and supply chain reliability. Its commitment to sustainability, including environmentally friendly materials, carbon reduction initiatives, and compliance with international standards (e.g., GRS, ISO certifications), enhances its market appeal. Innovation in high-value and niche products such as cooling leather, antiviral coatings, and automotive-grade materials further differentiates its offerings.
